Transcribes the audio your computer is playing — meeting calls, videos, anything on your speakers — into a Notion-style editor, live.

## Install

Download **SysAudio-Scribe Setup 0.2.0.exe** below and run it. It installs per-user, so no admin rights are needed.

**Windows will warn you.** The build is unsigned, so SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC" the first time. Choose **More info → Run anyway**. If you would rather not trust an unsigned binary, the source is here and `npm run dist:win` produces the same installer.

## You will need

- **Windows.** System-audio capture uses WASAPI loopback, which macOS has no equivalent for without a virtual audio device.
- **An API key** from either [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) or [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/keys). Transcription runs in the cloud; there is no local model. Keys are encrypted with the OS keystore and never leave the main process.
- *(Optional)* A [Gemini key](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey) if you want the clean-up pass.

## What changed since 0.1.0

**Fewer words lost.** Segments now overlap, so nothing falls into the gap between one recording stopping and the next starting — previously that cut roughly 180 small holes per hour of audio. The duplicated words this creates are stripped from the text afterwards.

**Better Thai word splitting.** Each request now carries the tail of the previous transcript as decoding context. Without it the model re-segmented every chunk from a cold start, which showed up as mangled syllables right after each boundary.

**The clean-up pass runs once, at the end.** It used to run on every 20-second fragment — the one unit where the model cannot tell how a sentence began, so it "fixed" fragments into confident nonsense. There is now a Polish button, and the automatic run happens when you stop recording.

**Model lists are fetched from the provider.** Press *Fetch models* in Settings instead of relying on whatever ids were current when the app was built. A retired model now says so plainly rather than failing with a bare status code.

**New icon**, and a reproducible pipeline that generates every size from one master.

**180 unit tests and CI** covering settings and key storage, the transcription request and its retries, the clean-up pass, the upload queue's ordering, and the model catalogue.

## Privacy

This app records audio and uploads it to whichever provider you configure. Please read the [Privacy section](https://github.com/jodpacharapon/SysAudio-Scribe#privacy) before recording anything you would not want a third party to process.
